method.analysis: Static reads and in-memory metadata only. Read the lens, then the whole packet (final.patch in full; claims, verification metadata, lineage, provenance, changed/context sources); traced every BmadDeterministicSetupError conversion and the wizard deterministic branch; checked each changed behavior against the tests that run it by reading the test files and searching the whole test tree for the exact error messages and symbols; checked that the three changed suite pins (19/11/26) equal static it() counts and the recorded run outputs (58 focused, 1794+409 full, 51/51 browser at the post-merge receipt sha); assessed the web corrections against their unit pin, e2e specs, snapshot comparisons, and provenance notes. No execution of any candidate script or test.
method.hash_verification: shasum -a 256, stdout capture only, no files written. Root pins (manifest.json, lens file) checked against the briefing hashes. Full 59-file packet sweep hashed once before the reading phase and once after all reads; plus an immediate before/after bracket for README.md. Every packet file read lies between its before-hash and after-hash and was compared to manifest.json (packet-file SHA-256 entries).
method.coverage_searches: grep over the frozen test/ tree and repo root for each converted-site message ('missing required bmad-build skill', 'binding escapes selected repo', 'ambiguous BMM/GDS config token', 'skill root is not a directory', 'skill binding is a symlink', 'owned payload contains symlink/unsupported entry', 'unsafe BMAD recorded skill path/tool', 'existing worktree manifest is malformed', 'refusing to overwrite non-Gru BMAD record', 'refusing BMAD control write through unsafe path', 'record is malformed', 'no longer exists', 'escapes the workspace root', 'invalid top-level path', 'not the Git repository root', 'Repair the reported condition deliberately'), plus import/call-site searches for onboardBmadRepo and BmadDeterministicSetupError.

hash_verification.notes: manifest.json is excluded from its own packet_files list; it was hashed in both sweeps and matched the briefing pin. All other packet files matched their manifest SHA-256 entries in both sweeps.

limits: No test/build/lint/typecheck/execution of any kind: verification gaps were assessed statically from source, tests, and recorded run evidence; the regression demonstrations are reasoned from the source, not executed.

No git object access (no .git reads, no ref movement): the relationship between the post-merge run sha faa69d69... and the frozen product head 5c0d1d3... was not independently re-derivable; packet wording was relied upon.

The manifest carries no product-file blob hashes (product_files_at_head is empty), so frozen-worktree content could not be cross-checked against manifest bindings; only the packet's own files were hash-bound.
PNG baselines were hash-verified and assessed from png/PROVENANCE.md and the e2e comparisons they feed; no visual read of the images was performed.
Pre-fix RED runs for the split r1 cases (scheduler-only wizard-bmad-retry-baseline scope) do not appear in the packet and were not reproduced.
Session/model identifiers are not observable without env/process/session reads, which this job forbids; recorded null.
variances: The post-merge green-set receipts bind sha faa69d69264a293296fffa7d773b083b2fa17135 (described in the packet as the post-merge 'packet commit head'); the frozen product head binding is 5c0d1d343639c4c96c0e387030f8c3ef6fddd445. The packet asserts the packet-only delta and treats the product tree as unchanged, but parentage was not re-derived (no git access).

verification/current-evidence.md labels faa69d69... 'Product head at capture' while the frozen binding names 5c0d1d3... - same observation as the first variance entry, restated where the packet makes it; no separate finding raised.
manifest.json product_files_at_head is an empty array although README.md states the manifest lists per-file blob hashes of diff-touched product files - recorded as the single 'other' finding.
